landmarks.name: stone pillar between doorways
landmarks.description: thick rough-hewn grey stone wall section separating two doorways off the main stair landing

landmarks.name: bed with turquoise runner
landmarks.description: large bed with white quilted cover, a turquoise patterned runner at the foot, and a dark brown wooden headboard with vertical slats and a central square panel containing an X motif

landmarks.name: wooden stair railing
landmarks.description: dark stained wooden balustrade with thick flat balusters bordering the stairwell

landmarks.name: bed with red runner
landmarks.description: double bed with a white cover, white painted wooden headboard, and a dark red fringed runner at the foot

landmarks.name: white distressed dresser
landmarks.description: chest of drawers painted distressed white with dark handles, topped by a mirror and a small wall-mounted TV nearby

landmarks.name: white radiator on stone wall
landmarks.description: white metal panel radiator mounted low on a rough stone wall just inside the doorway near the bed with the red runner

landmarks.name: red fire extinguisher
landmarks.description: red cylinder fire extinguisher mounted on the wall where the white plaster meets the stone by the stairs

landmarks.name: recessed window with stone sill
landmarks.description: small rectangular window set deep into the thick exterior stone wall at the stair landing, with a small grey jug on the sill

landmarks.name: small white radiator on white wall
landmarks.description: compact white radiator mounted on a plain white wall between a corner and a doorway on the landing

landmarks.name: single bed with white cover
landmarks.description: twin bed covered in a plain white bedspread with folded towel swans on top, positioned against a stone wall

landmarks.name: framed flower painting on stone wall
landmarks.description: small square painting of white flowers in a thick rustic wooden frame hung on the stone wall near an inner doorway

landmarks.name: white corner bathtub
landmarks.description: white acrylic corner tub against a beige mosaic-tiled wall

landmarks.name: white pedestal sink with stone-framed mirror
landmarks.description: white ceramic pedestal sink mounted on a rough stone wall beneath a rectangular mirror with a light-colored textured frame

landmarks.name: white toilet by stone wall
landmarks.description: white ceramic toilet positioned in the corner of two stone walls next to a small metal trash can

landmarks.name: dark wooden sliding closet doors
landmarks.description: tall dark brown wooden doors set flush into the left wall of a narrow passage

landmarks.name: two twin beds with orange pillows
landmarks.description: pair of single beds with white covers, dark X-frame headboards against a rough stone wall, and bright orange throw pillows, separated by a small white nightstand

landmarks.name: two twin beds with blue pillows
landmarks.description: pair of single beds with white covers, white horizontal-slat headboards on a stone wall, and dark blue throw pillows

landmarks.name: window with light blue curtains
landmarks.description: window with dark wooden shutters and sheer light blue curtains tied back, above a white radiator

landmarks.name: curved glass corner shower
landmarks.description: corner shower stall with curved clear glass doors and pinkish-beige mosaic wall tiles

landmarks.name: white toilet with mosaic tile backing
landmarks.description: white ceramic toilet set against a half-wall of pinkish-beige mosaic tiles next to a stone wall

landmarks.name: white pedestal sink with wood-framed mirror
landmarks.description: white pedestal sink on a stone wall beneath a rectangular mirror with a warm brown wooden frame

landmarks.name: blue woven basket
landmarks.description: rectangular turquoise-blue woven storage basket sitting on a surface near the doorway by the twin beds with blue pillows

landmarks.name: white radiator by doorway
landmarks.description: white metal panel radiator mounted on a plain white wall between the narrow passage and the twin beds with orange pillows

landmarks.name: tall window with white sheer curtains
landmarks.description: tall narrow window with a wooden railing at the bottom, wooden shutters, and white sheer curtains tied back

landmarks.name: white woven basket on red bench
landmarks.description: rectangular white woven storage basket sitting on a red patterned bench against a white wall beneath a wall-mounted TV

connections.how: Go forward through the right-hand doorway with the stone pillar on your left and turn right toward the bed.
Turn around and exit through the doorway with the stone pillar on your right to face the wooden stair railing on your left.
With the wooden stair railing behind you, step through the doorway to the left of the stone pillar; the bed with the red runner is on your right and the white distressed dresser is ahead.
Turn around with the white radiator on the stone wall on your right and walk out the doorway to the wooden stair railing.
Walk down the stairs with the wooden stair railing on your left toward the red fire extinguisher and the recessed window with the stone sill ahead on the left.

connections.to: small white radiator on white wall
connections.how: Turn around in the stone corner and walk back up the stairs with the wooden stair railing on your right and the stone pillar on your left to face the small white radiator on the white wall ahead.

connections.from: small white radiator on white wall
connections.how: Turn left and re-enter the doorway to the left of the stone pillar, passing the white distressed dresser on your left and the bed with the red runner on your right.

connections.to: framed flower painting on stone wall
connections.how: Walk across the floor past the bed with the red runner and the single bed with the white cover on your right to approach the open wooden doorway next to the framed flower painting on the stone wall.

connections.from: framed flower painting on stone wall
connections.how: Step through the doorway beside the flower painting into the tiled space where the white corner bathtub is on your left, and pan right to see the white pedestal sink with the stone-framed mirror and the white toilet by the stone wall.
Exit the tiled space through the doorway, walking past the single bed with the white cover on your left and toward the bed with the red runner and white distressed dresser.

connections.to: small white radiator on white wall
connections.how: Walk past the white distressed dresser and white radiator on the stone wall on your right, exiting through the doorway onto the landing with the wooden stair railing on your right and the small white radiator on the white wall on your left.

connections.from: small white radiator on white wall
connections.how: Enter the doorway to the right of the small white radiator and walk into the narrow passage with the dark wooden sliding closet doors on your left and the two twin beds with orange pillows visible ahead.
Turn around in the narrow passage and walk back out to the landing with the wooden stair railing on your left, facing the stone pillar between doorways ahead.

connections.to: two twin beds with blue pillows
connections.how: Turn back toward the white wall and enter the doorway to the left of the narrow passage (next to the small white radiator) to face the two twin beds with blue pillows ahead.

connections.from: two twin beds with blue pillows
connections.how: Look left toward the window with light blue curtains, then turn toward the inner doorway beside the curtains.

Step through the inner doorway beside the light blue curtains into the tiled space with the curved glass corner shower ahead, the white toilet with mosaic tile backing, and the white pedestal sink with the wood-framed mirror on the right.

connections.to: two twin beds with blue pillows
connections.how: Step back out through the doorway with the two twin beds with blue pillows on your left and the blue woven basket on your right.

connections.from: two twin beds with blue pillows
connections.how: Walk out through the main doorway onto the landing with the wooden stair railing on your left and turn right.

connections.to: two twin beds with orange pillows
connections.how: Turn back toward the narrow passage with the dark wooden sliding closet doors and walk forward past the white radiator by the doorway on your left toward the two twin beds with orange pillows ahead.

connections.from: two twin beds with orange pillows
connections.to: tall window with white sheer curtains
connections.how: Walk forward between the foot of the twin beds with orange pillows on your left and the white woven basket on the red bench on your right toward the tall window with white sheer curtains ahead.

connections.from: tall window with white sheer curtains
connections.how: Turn around in place near the window to face back between the white woven basket on the red bench on your left and the two twin beds with orange pillows on your right toward the white radiator by the doorway ahead.

walk_summary: Pass the stone pillar between doorways on the left to enter the doorway toward the bed with the turquoise runner.
Turn around and exit back to the wooden stair railing and stone pillar.
Enter the doorway to the left of the stone pillar past the white radiator on the stone wall to view the bed with the red runner and the white distressed dresser.
Turn around, exit to the wooden stair railing, and walk partway down the stairs toward the red fire extinguisher and the recessed window with the stone sill.
Turn around in the stone corner and walk back up the stairs past the wooden stair railing to face the small white radiator on the white wall.

Re-enter the doorway to the left of the stone pillar, walking past the white distressed dresser and the bed with the red runner toward the single bed with the white cover and the framed flower painting on the stone wall.
Step through the doorway beside the flower painting to view the white corner bathtub, the white pedestal sink with the stone-framed mirror, and the white toilet by the stone wall.

Walk back out past the single bed with the white cover, the bed with the red runner, and the white distressed dresser to return to the landing by the wooden stair railing and the small white radiator on the white wall.
Enter the narrow passage to the right of the small white radiator, passing the dark wooden sliding closet doors on the left with a view of the twin beds with orange pillows ahead.
Turn around and walk back out to the landing facing the stone pillar between doorways.
Enter the doorway next to the small white radiator toward the two twin beds with blue pillows and the window with light blue curtains.

Step through the inner doorway beside the light blue curtains to see the curved glass corner shower, the white toilet with mosaic tile backing, and the white pedestal sink with the wood-framed mirror.
Step back out past the two twin beds with blue pillows and the blue woven basket, then exit onto the landing by the wooden stair railing.
Walk back through the narrow passage past the white radiator by the doorway toward the two twin beds with orange pillows.

Walk between the two twin beds with orange pillows and the white woven basket on the red bench to the tall window with white sheer curtains, then turn around to face the white radiator by the doorway.

source.camera: held at chest height by a person walking
